messages:
alex Hi — quick brain dump: our current alert spike is still paging on every GPU transient. Can we discuss a funnel that auto-ticket low-impact flares and only pager sustained or cross-rack failures?

maria yes please. the noise is burning the rotation and we miss real perf regressions. idea: two-stage rule set -> ticket if <3 nodes affected for <5m, pager if >3 nodes or >5m.

kevin +1. also add a region-weighted threshold: some eu clusters can be noisier, so escalate slower unless latency SLO trips.

samir What about grouping by pod/deployment label? We get many alerts per job during batched workloads. If we group by deployment and dedupe within 2m, that should reduce duplicates.

alex agree. proposal: primary filters = severity (SRE-high), cardinality (>3 hosts OR namespace==infra), duration > 5m, and SLO breach flag. fallback ticketing for everything else.

maria can you sketch the prometheus expr for the sustained case?

kevin sure — rough: ```
count_over_time(gpu_memory_failures_total[5m]) by (node) > 3
```
then wrap with `increase(...)` to ignore single-sample blips.

samir also think we should rely on the SLO bridge metric: `slo_error_budget_burn` to force pager when the burn_rate > 2 despite low cardinality.

alex good call. that lets business impact override cardinality heuristics.

ops-bot FYI: recent paging histogram for GPU OOMs -> 72% of pages were single-sample spikes (last 30d). Link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/alerts/gpu-ooms

maria so action items: 1) implement rule prototype with duration and grouping 2) add slo-override path 3) add mute-window for nightly scheduled jobs 4) run simulated firing on staging.

kevin i'll take 1 and 3. will add a 00:00-06:00 mute-window for scheduled batch jobs, but keep a hard SLO override.

samir i'll wire the SLO metric into the routing logic and add a quicktest dashboard.

alex assign: @oncall-rotation please review policy after changes for escalation docs.

oncall-rotation ack. i'll review and propose a canary rollout (1 cluster -> 3 regions) and sync with pagerduty routing.

maria timeline?

kevin aiming PR by EOD tomorrow, config change + alerts smoke test on staging.

alex thanks. if we see regressions we revert to old rule and open a postmortem. :thumbsup:
